ConnectionStrings._AscendantEmpireDatabase_comment: No default here on purpose. A server name is machine-specific, so anything put in this base file becomes the silent fallback in every environment. Set it per machine with: dotnet user-secrets set "ConnectionStrings:AscendantEmpireDatabase" "<your connection string>", or via the ConnectionStrings__AscendantEmpireDatabase environment variable. Startup fails with an explicit message when it is missing. A local development value lives in appsettings.Development.json.

Cors._AllowedOrigins_comment: No default here on purpose, for the same reason as the connection string above: the origin the frontend is served from is per-environment, so anything in this base file becomes the silent fallback everywhere. Set it per environment in that environment's appsettings file, with user-secrets, or via indexed environment variables (Cors__AllowedOrigins__0, Cors__AllowedOrigins__1, ...). Each entry is a scheme, host and optional port and nothing else - no trailing slash, path or wildcard. Startup fails with an explicit message when the list is empty. A local development value lives in appsettings.Development.json.

Jwt._SigningKey_comment: Do NOT put the real signing key here. Set it via user-secrets: dotnet user-secrets set "Jwt:SigningKey" "<a long random secret>". A dev placeholder lives in appsettings.Development.json.

Bootstrap._AdminUsername_comment: Set to an existing username to grant it every permission at startup, but only while no account holds SystemPanel. This is the way in on a database with no administrator yet; leave it blank once one exists.

ExportSettings._TempDirectory_comment: Deliberately unset. ExportSettings.TempDirectory falls back to <system temp>/AscendantEmpire/Exports, which is valid on any machine. Override it per environment (appsettings.Development.json, user-secrets or ExportSettings__TempDirectory) rather than here, so no one machine's disk layout becomes the all-environment default.

MapGenerationSettings._OutputDirectory_comment: Deliberately unset. MapGenerationSettings.OutputDirectory falls back to <system temp>/AscendantEmpire/MapPreviews, which is valid on any machine. Override it per environment (appsettings.Development.json, user-secrets or MapGenerationSettings__OutputDirectory) rather than here.
